items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: James McGaffick, Sr., owned more slaves than anybody in Virginia... He had my great-grandfather by this woman...

ctx.x: How about your mom? Where was she from?

My mother – we trace her ancestry pretty good. She’s the daughter of a woman who was 50% Cherokee, whose mother was full-blooded Cherokee and married a son of the biggest slave-owner in Virginia. James McGaffick, Sr., owned more slaves than anybody in Virginia. Lived in Wythe County. He had my great-grandfather by this woman who was his favorite, much like Thomas Jefferson. He had a great regard for his son. He took care of his son and sent him to school, educated him, but he sold his mother. So his son was…
